title: Rockets in the Rain
text:
(1) to the local tourism office, more than 20,000 visitors came to the Rocket Festival in Yasothon last weekend. (2) the bad weather, the festival was a great success. It was (3) a colorful event that many tourists stayed for all three days. Visitors enjoyed the music and dancing (4) the famous rocket competition.
"(5) I am concerned, this is the best festival in Thailand," said one visitor from Bangkok. The organizers built a new car park (6) to reduce traffic in the town. (7) the other hand, some residents complained about the noise. "We do not mind the festival (8) it ends before midnight," said one shop owner. The mayor promised to meet residents (9) soon as the festival was over. He said the town would rather (10) the festival bigger than lose its visitors.

items.stem: (1) ___ to the local tourism office, more than 20,000 visitors came to the Rocket Festival in Yasothon last weekend.
items.explanation_th: According to = ตามที่ (แหล่งข้อมูล) ระบุ
why_wrong: Because to ผิดรูป
Instead to ผิดรูป
Spite to ผิดรูป

items.stem: (2) ___ the bad weather, the festival was a great success.
items.explanation_th: อากาศแย่แต่สำเร็จ = ทั้งที่ → In spite of
why_wrong: Because of ความหมายกลับ
Instead of ความหมายผิด
In case of ความหมายผิด

items.stem: (3) It was ___ a colorful event that many tourists stayed for all three days.
why_wrong: so ใช้กับ adj ไม่มีคำนาม
too ไม่ใช้กับ that
very ไม่ใช้กับ that

items.stem: (4) Visitors enjoyed the music and dancing ___ the famous rocket competition.
items.explanation_th: as well as = รวมถึง
why_wrong: as long as ความหมายผิด
as far as ความหมายผิด
as soon as ความหมายผิด

items.stem: (5) "___ I am concerned, this is the best festival in Thailand,"
items.explanation_th: As far as I am concerned = สำหรับฉันแล้ว
why_wrong: As long as ความหมายผิด
As well as ความหมายผิด
As soon as ความหมายผิด

items.stem: (6) The organizers built a new car park ___ to reduce traffic in the town.
items.explanation_th: in order to + V1 = เพื่อที่จะ
why_wrong: so that ต้องตามด้วยประโยค
because to ผิด
such to ผิด

items.stem: (7) ___ the other hand, some residents complained about the noise.
items.explanation_th: On the other hand = ในทางกลับกัน
why_wrong: In the other hand ผิด
At the other hand ผิด
By the other hand ผิด

items.stem: (8) "We do not mind the festival ___ it ends before midnight,"
items.explanation_th: ไม่ว่า ตราบใดที่เลิกก่อนเที่ยงคืน → as long as
why_wrong: as far as ความหมายผิด
as well as ความหมายผิด
as soon as ความหมายผิด

items.stem: (9) The mayor promised to meet residents ___ soon as the festival was over.
items.explanation_th: as soon as = ทันทีที่
why_wrong: so soon as ไม่ใช่รูปมาตรฐาน
such soon ผิด
too soon as ผิด

items.stem: (10) He said the town would rather ___ the festival bigger than lose its visitors.
why_wrong: would rather ไม่ตามด้วย to
ไม่ตามด้วย V-ing
made ผิด
